Game Overview

In Turnip, the core idea is straightforward: chomp your way to victory in the adorably addictive world of Turnip. As an idle clicker game, gobble turnips to boost your score and unlock powerful upgrades. With seamless auto-saves and rewarding mechanics, Turnip delivers a quirky, engaging adventure perfect for both active and idle play.
